build_loss_lpips: build a perceptual loss function using LPIPS with VGG network for image similarity
build_loss_combined: build a combined perceptual loss from multiple weighted loss types like lpips+0.1_mse
create_perceptual_loss_instance: create a PerceptualLoss instance with a string specifying loss type and optional weights
test_perceptual_loss_forward: test the PerceptualLoss forward method by passing original and warped image tensors
build_loss_watson_vgg: build a Watson VGG perceptual loss with pretrained weights for video quality assessment
